messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — I'm doing a sweep of the Quickstart auth snippets (hello-starter + minimal). Found 3 issues: env var naming mismatch, token-refresh example missing in SDK, and a broken link to creds page. Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/312
sam: Nice, thanks. Should we also update the REST curl examples to use the new header `x-rw-api-key` (we changed from Authorization header last quarter)?
anya: Yes — the new standard is `x-rw-api-key`. I'll update curl + python + node snippets. Will leave a note about migrating from `Authorization: Bearer`.
kevin: Token refresh is still important for our on-prem users. Can we add a short example showing refreshing a short-lived token w/ client credentials? I can draft if you want.
julia: I can take the Node SDK snippet. Quick question: do we prefer `process.env.RW_API_KEY` or `process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY` naming in examples?
mike: small thing — in the Quickstart step "Configure credentials" the link points to /docs/cred-setup which 404s. I'll open an issue.
anya: Good catch, mike. I'll change link to /docs/credentials/setup. (I ran the link check locally and missed that one)
kevin: I'll add the refresh snippet. Proposed minimal code:
```
// refresh token pseudo
const refresh = async () => {
  const r = await fetch('https://auth.redwood.ai/token', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({grant_type: 'client_credentials'}),
  });
  const {access_token} = await r.json();
  process.env.RW_API_KEY = access_token;
};
```
sam: For REST curl example use:
```
curl -H "x-rw-api-key: $RW_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"hi\"}'
```
anya: small nit — use `RW_API_KEY` in examples to keep things short. Add comment for secure storage.
mike: opened issue #98 for the broken link.
docs-bot: CI check passed for docs/pull/312 — 14 files changed, 5 failures fixed
anya: ok I'm going to land a small PR with link fixes + curl/node changes, then follow up with kevin's refresh + julia's node snippet as a separate PR. If anyone wants to pair, ping me.
sam: :thumbsup: I'll review the PR later today.
julia: I'll start the Node snippet branch, will ping when I have a draft.
kevin: adding the refresh snippet now.
anya: thanks all. I'll add a migration note at top: "If you used Authorization header, switch to x-rw-api-key and rotate keys."
